metadata.name: Razor Edge
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: An industrial base round an open atrium under a storm. A raised platform in the middle, a bridge across the north side, galleries all round a storey up, and the railgun ledge high on the south wall: ride the pad on the south gallery to reach it, or the lift pad from the atrium floor to the west gallery. Side corridors loop round the atrium; a water channel runs below the south hall with the rocket launcher, and the heavy armour stands on a pillar over the slime pit in the east wing.
